contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP LIC]INIVS PF AVG ; R/ GENIO POP ROM

Copper alloy coin. Smaller module Tetrarchic nummus of Licinius I (308-324), London mint Genio Pop Rom issue, issue of 316, RIC volume 7 no. 52. Obverse description: Bearded bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP LIC]INIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left, right hand extended, cornucopiae and cloak in left arm. Possibly S T in field. Reverse inscription: GENIO…
